# Entice HR Solutions

## About Us
Entice HR Solutions acts as an extended HR squad for fast-growing startups, mid-sized enterprises, and MNCs. We specialize in AI-powered recruitment, executive search, and statutory payroll solutions.

## Core Services
- Recruitment & Talent Acquisition
- Executive Search & Leadership Hiring
- Complete HR Outsourcing & Virtual HR
- Statutory Compliance & Payroll Management
- Learning & Development

## Key Metrics & Guarantees
- 15,000+ Placement Records
- Guaranteed 2-hour response time for proposals
- 90-Day Free Replacement Guarantee
- AI-powered matching engine scanning 20M+ candidate profiles
